description:
*“Want to grab a drink?”*

Seo Mu-Kyung, heir to the SL Group. Having always lived in the position of a dominant predator, he is arrogant and authoritative. Yet a new desire has found him. A woman he wants to conquer and obsess over has appeared. He wants her completely. Even if it means cutting short her career.

*‘This wasn't how I wanted to get close to her...’*

Choi Yu-Yeon, SL's youngest employee, has secretly loved Seo Mu-Kyung. Under his instinct-driven dominance, she's always helpless. She couldn't tell him. That she'd liked him for so long. Afraid he'd stop desiring her. But as their relationship deepens, she thinks. This relationship... must end now.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
